book.title: APALYNAH JOHAN TEI A HMUHPAW APALYNAH BIA

content: Khazing thingaenah kaity sangsarih
Mataico behnah ing taikhei vaiming pasarih khah, “Va sei la, Khazing thingaenah kaity sangsarih khah alui letah va tlaihly o,” tatah a thangpui tah a tahpaw he khah ka thui.

Vaiming a pakhehnah cawh va sei ka, a kaity cawh alui letah va tlaihly ka, sawhrang a tei cangnah ngianah a hnuipaw le ama a lopaw nono a behpaw sahlo cawh a hmui a chiahrupaw le a sah ngeteipaw hmawchia takhei a e he.
Vaiming a pahningnah taco, a kaity cawh rili lekhei va tlaihly ka, tui cawh mehthi thi hrakhei a tua ka, rili chung letei a ungpaw hringnah a hnuipaw maikaw cawh a thi thlu he.
Vaiming a pathungnah taco, a kaity cawh tuivaw le tuihnaw lekhei va tlaihly ka, tui cawh thisai tah a tua he.
Mataico tui a mingkaipaw vaiming takhei,

content.text: “Nama cawh a ung leimeipaw le a ung thahpaw,
Nama cawh na biacepanah sahlo lehei na ding,
zecawtamaw tatah dingná tah bia na ce.
Zecawtamaw tatah aaning taco na mehpathai sahlo le Khazing khuavang sahlo khah aa thisai laisah he ka,
Nama tah peh phu a cangpaw he thisai khah ding pawtah na peh myca he,”

content: a tahpaw khah ka thui.
Taico dangnah siasang taitei chainah o tah,

content.text: na biacenah cawh a dihpaw le a dingpaw a cang,”

content: a tahpaw khah ka thui.
Vaiming a papalinah taco, a kaity khah ning cung letah tlaihly ka, ning cawh me tah cawngsaw a kang khypaw hmingtuakhynah khah peh a cang.

Aaning sahlo cawh a sah ngeteipaw palingnah takhei kangpa-uh he ka, ma hrehnah sahlo cung letei naw a hnuitu Khazing ming khah aa reipachia, canghrasala a ngepachih tah ama khah parungnawsah du hlui bei he.
Vaiming a papangawnah takhei, a kaity cawh sawhrang abui dyching lekhei tlaihly ka, a painah raang cawh muinah tah a bakhu. Cawngsaw cawh aa taithui tunah cawtah aa lui khah ty he ka,
taithuinah aa ingpaw le hmawchia aa ingpaw rawng takhei, vaicung Khazing khah aa pachia aa pahru. Canghrasala aa tuasapaw hming caw tei a ngepachih khah du hlui bei he.
Vaiming a paruhnah takhei, a kaity cawh Zufreti tuivaw pui letah tlaihly ka, tui cawh kih ka, nichualang tei siangpahrang sahlo aa langpui ruapaw takhei a tua he.
Mataico ca-uh ky a lopaw thlawpaw pialuipaw sangthung ka hmuh he. Aaning sahlo cawh paribui kaw le sawhrang kaw le khuavang pakheipaw kaw taikhei aa kapiapaw a cang he.

Aaning sahlo cawh ningang chuipaw paching pakhanah a tuapaw khachia thlawpaw cang he ka, Khazing Zezong Tuatu ning rungnawpaw ning letah a dy he seh tah pawtah khazaw siangpahrang sahlo pahmo rua pawtah a sei he.
“Ngetua, mehru hratah ka vong a! A hrah thlang katei, a chaichi raering teitah a chia thlangpaw cawngsaw cawh bonghnang a ting, ma pawsui co, ama cawh thlekalong tah le muaphy tah ung be,” a tah.
Mataico siangpahrang sahlo khah Hebru rei tei Armagedon aa tahpaw hminghmaw lekhei thlawpaw pialuipaw sahlo takhei hmingkheh tah aa pahmo he.
Taico, a hningcaipaw vaiming a pasarihnah takhei, a kaity cawh zizaw lekhei tlaihly ka, behnah ing chung letei Abui dyching taikhei o va ring ka, “A chang myca!” tatah a tah.
Mataico lailaw va ky, o va ring, khalung a thih tah ka, aling a rupui tah a hrui. Alui lehei cawngsaw aa ungnah taitah ma tluh a rupaw aling cawh a hrui bang be.

Alaipaw khuapui cawh chythung tah a chy ka, raang sahlo letei khuapui sahlo cawh a rawh cehceh he. Khazing tah Babilon khuapui cawh a thui thlang ka, a thingaenah misurhang zu tei a chihpaw ny khah ama cawh a dingsah.
Tuiraw raang maikaw cawh ly thlu he ka, tlaang sahlo cawh hmuh khy cang khawh bei he.

Avai taitah pong zakheh hrawnghrang a rihpaw aria alaipaw pui sahlo khah cawngsaw cung letah a tlah he. Taico aria tah hrehnah rawng taco Khazing khah aa reipachia, zecawtamaw tatah ma hrehnah cawh a saw tunah cawtah a cang.
